answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 183151 Country: united+states Title: What is the ruling on having a bathroom attached to the bedroom? Question: What is the ruling on having a bathroom attached to the bedroom? The two are separated by wall and door. I have heard it is not Islamic to have an attached bathroom. Answer ID: 183151 Posted on: Nov 2, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 317/253/B=3/1443) People do this to save space and get more room etc. You can do so. It is convenient for the elder, sick and weak people. However, it is better if the bathroom is separate. However, it is not correct to call it an un-Islamic way. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
